# Program Kit

Program Kit supports product intake and native Spec Kit feature delivery.
Development is private; documentation and approved downloads are public.

- [Documentation](https://github.com/orbyss-io/program-kit-releases/blob/main/docs/README.md)
- [Installation](https://github.com/orbyss-io/program-kit-releases/blob/main/docs/installation.md)
- [Usage](https://github.com/orbyss-io/program-kit-releases/blob/main/docs/usage.md)
- [AI assistant instructions](https://github.com/orbyss-io/program-kit-releases/blob/main/docs/ai-assistants.md)
- [Versioned downloads](https://github.com/orbyss-io/program-kit-releases/releases)

Use the matching release tag for previews. The automatic GitHub source archive is
the public distribution tree, not the complete tooling archive. Download the named
program-kit-tooling asset for update/recovery inputs.
